name: Baksan
summary: A long-running liquid-scintillator telescope at the Baksan Neutrino Observatory searches for stellar-collapse bursts and studies cosmic-ray and neutrino-induced muons.
detection_principle: Layered scintillation counters measure charged-particle energy deposition and timing. A supernova produces a short excess of low-energy events, principally through inverse beta decay in the scintillator.

results.summary: The Baksan burst was reported as a neutrino signal associated with SN1987A.
Decades of monitoring constrain the rate of Galactic stellar collapses.
